purpose: Ajouter un socle générique d'agenda portable et de visioconférence provider-agnostic.
implemented_bricks: standard agenda action buttons with ICS fallback
Jitsi IFrame API adapter with custom-domain support
design_rules: ICS is the universal calendar fallback.
Provider-specific URL generation and API mappings live only in adapters.
Jitsi is the default meeting provider but not embedded in the generic meeting model.
Self-hosted Jitsi domains are supported through configuration.
Secrets and JWT tokens must never be serialized into public framework artefacts.
Calendar events use explicit timezone information by default.
